_about: Hand-read key signatures for Beethoven 5 p.15 (IMSLP984073, PDF page index
15, printed page 15, bars 430 and 452). Read off a 500 dpi render of the
beet5_p15_sys1_headers.png is the image the lower system was read from.
This page had no per-staff ground truth before. The 2026-08-29 blindspot
report says so explicitly and is why its +4 gain there was called
unverifiable. It is the page roadmap #4b cites as its primary evidence, so
`fifths` is the WRITTEN signature: +N sharps, -N flats, 0 for none. Both
systems carry the same instrumentation and the same signatures; the values
below apply to each of the two systems.
Note what the natural brass and the timpani print: NOTHING, on a page in
three flats. The modern MusicXML edition the dossier is generated from
gives C Trumpet and Timpani written_fifths -3, so the dossier and this
print disagree about 3 of the 11 parts. That is an edition difference, not
